summary: Verified security fixes SEC-001..SEC-004 and ran a regression pass. Backend: added test_security_fixes.py (19 tests). Moved the 3 existing suites off demo-* tokens (they now get tokens from /api/dashboard) and off /api/vapi/* (they now use /api/portal/{token}/agent/tools|end). Result: 67/67 pass when run serially (-n 0). SEC-001: /api/vapi/tools returns 200 {results:[{toolCallId,error:'Unauthorized'}]} with no secret or a wrong one; no quote is created and Maya stays walkthru_initiated. /api/vapi/webhook returns {received:false} and does not end Maya's call. The portal agent endpoints only act on the lead in the URL token: a lead_token for a different lead in the body is ignored. SEC-002: all tokens are 22-char urlsafe and unique, /portal/demo-* returns 404, and reset rotates the tokens. SEC-003: a foreign Origin (and a lookalike host suffix) gets 403 'Cross-site request blocked' for PATCH/POST with Bearer or cookie. Same-origin requests work, and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header is sent. SEC-004: frames with no call -> 400, >600k -> 422, non-JPEG -> 422, the 301st frame -> 429; captions stop at 400 lines; caption >2000 chars -> 422. Frontend at 390px: full mock voice call on Luis (v1 $19,000-$23,000 -> v2 $25,000 to $30,500 -> quote $27,600 -> sign -> contract (name prefilled) -> deposit $1,380 -> redirect to checkout.stripe.com). It only used call/start, agent/tools x2 and agent/end, with no /vapi calls. Chat mode reached $27,600 the same way. Talk to change this on Elena: v2 $14,400 -> v3 $12,408. Priya's fallback screen is correct. Dashboard at 1920px: agent switch, Start agent on Dana (simulated SMS), take over Maya, recall Tom, and Luis showing as Pending deposit all worked with zero 4xx. /dev: without a cookie it shows the login screen; create TEST_ lead, advance, Open portal (random token) and Reset all work.

minor.issue: No lead-status/active-call guard. On Ana (pending_deposit, contract v1, payment $1,945), get_quote_estimate saved quote v2 $15,500 status 'sent'. Afterwards the portal quote and the dashboard quote_total showed 15500 while the contract and payment stayed on v1/$1,945. Anyone with the link can rewrite the quote after signing; this likely also applies to deposit_received leads. Fix: only run tools when the lead has an active call session (or status is walkthru_initiated or walkthru_completed/quote_generated for the change flow), and reject contract_sent/pending_deposit/deposit_received/dropped like start_call does.
The 300-frame cap is checked with count-then-insert, so parallel requests can go slightly over the cap. Low risk.
Once VAPI_SERVER_SECRET is set, an authorized Vapi call with no lead_token still falls back to 'most recent walkthru_initiated lead', so it can act on the wrong lead. Consider requiring lead_token.
The cookie is still SameSite=None. CSRF is now mitigated by the Origin check; SameSite=Lax would add defense in depth (frontend and API are same-origin).

action_items: Guard /api/portal/{token}/agent/tools (and optionally agent/end) by lead status or active call so a signed/paid quote can't be rewritten from the portal link
Optional: make the frame cap atomic, require lead_token in the Vapi resolve_lead, and use a SameSite=Lax cookie
critical_code_review_comments: vapi_authorized uses hmac.compare_digest and is locked when the secret is unset: correct
portal agent_tools/agent_end correctly ignore the body lead_token (they use lead_by_token from the URL)
run_tool_calls has no status check, so the portal path inherits the old 'quote can change at any stage' behaviour
same_origin(): if the Origin header is missing the request is allowed (fine for non-browser clients with Bearer). It compares against x-forwarded-host, which works behind this ingress
CORS allow_credentials is disabled for the wildcard: verified on preflight and on simple GET
The mock adapter still puts lead_token in variableValues. This is harmless but redundant

/app/backend/tests/test_auth_google.py (demo-luis -> 404, checkout tests use the dashboard token)

flaky_tests: With pytest-xdist (default -n 2), test_portal_flow and test_dev_advance_from_pending_deposit fail because module fixtures in different workers call /dev/reset concurrently, which also rotates tokens. This is a test isolation problem, not an app bug. Run with -n 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Portal tokens are random and rotate on /dev/reset, so always look them up from /api/dashboard or Mongo after a reset. The full mock voice call takes about 65s; Talk to change takes about 32s. /api/vapi/* is always Unauthorized while VAPI_SERVER_SECRET is unset. The users collection still holds the pre-existing divi@velvee.ai user (test-user-e197abe586). It was not created by this run, so it was left in place.
